phrases.latin: «Massa nunc dormiet,» inquit pater; et eam in frīgidārium condidit.
phrases.english: “The dough will sleep now,” said Dad, and put it in the fridge.

phrases.latin: Cūr massa dormit? — Ut requiēscat; tum melius extenditur.
phrases.english: Why is the dough sleeping? — To rest; then it rolls out better.
